scope_note: A catalogue, not findings. This records that a report exists, on what, when, of what type, for which government, and where to read it. Nothing here reads or characterises an audit conclusion: those are the CAG's to publish. What this adds is the list of what has been audited, which is not published as a list anywhere.
source: Comptroller and Auditor General of India, audit report index
subject_note: A CAG title is not a scheme name. Some contain one, 'on Green India Mission'; many name a function of government instead, 'on State Finances, Government of Jharkhand'. `subject` is the title with its boilerplate stripped, and is null where nothing survives, so only titles that could name a scheme are ever offered to a matcher.
